required_patterns.component-architecture: All components must be Angular standalone components with explicit imports array
required_patterns.ui-library: PrimeNG components must be used for all UI elements
required_patterns.signal-based-state: Component state must use Angular signals (signal() API) instead of traditional properties
required_patterns.template-separation: Templates must be in separate .html files, styles in separate .css files

architectural_constraints.component-architecture: Components use standalone: true (implicit in Angular 20), no NgModules allowed
architectural_constraints.ui-library: All UI components must import from PrimeNG modules (e.g., ButtonModule), no custom UI framework mixing
architectural_constraints.signal-based-state: Use signal() for reactive state, avoid traditional property binding where signals are more appropriate
architectural_constraints.template-separation: Each component must have three files: .ts (logic), .html (template), .css (styles)

required_patterns.router-configuration: Routes must be defined in app.routes.ts as a Routes array
required_patterns.router-integration: Router must be provided via provideRouter() in app.config.ts

architectural_constraints.router-integration: Router outlet must be present in root app.html template

required_patterns.bootstrap-method: Application must bootstrap using bootstrapApplication() function with standalone root component
required_patterns.configuration-provider: All providers must be configured in appConfig object in app.config.ts
required_patterns.provider-functions: Use provider functions (provideRouter, provideAnimationsAsync, providePrimeNG, etc.)

architectural_constraints.bootstrap-method: main.ts must import and bootstrap the App component using bootstrapApplication()
architectural_constraints.configuration-provider: ApplicationConfig must be exported from app.config.ts and passed to bootstrapApplication()
architectural_constraints.provider-functions: All framework configurations use modern provider functions, no NgModule-based configuration

required_patterns.primeng-theming: PrimeNG theme must be configured using providePrimeNG with theme preset

architectural_constraints.primeng-theming: Theme configuration uses Aura preset from @primeuix/themes
architectural_constraints.global-styles: Global styles should be minimal, component styles should be scoped
architectural_constraints.component-styles: Styles referenced via styleUrl property in component decorator

required_patterns.unit-testing-framework: Jasmine test framework with Karma runner
required_patterns.test-colocation: Test files colocated with source files

architectural_constraints.unit-testing-framework: All tests use Jasmine syntax (describe, it, expect)
architectural_constraints.test-colocation: Tests live alongside the code they test (e.g., app.spec.ts next to app.ts)
